jobs.occupation: Full time chef wanted for busy cafe/bar.
jobs.description:
Full-Time Chef – Cafe Svejk

Job Description

As a full-time chef at Cafe Svejk, you will be responsible for preparing and serving high-quality food while maintaining a clean, organised, and efficient kitchen. You will play an important role in ensuring consistent food quality, excellent hygiene standards, and a positive dining experience for our guests.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Food Preparation and Cooking: Prepare, cook, and present dishes according to Cafe Svejk’s menu and quality standards.

• 
Food Hygiene and Safety: Maintain high standards of cleanliness and hygiene in accordance with food safety regulations, including proper food handling, storage, temperature control, and prevention of cross-contamination.

• 
Kitchen Cleaning: Keep all kitchen areas, equipment, utensils, and workstations clean, sanitised, and organised throughout the working day.

• 
Stock Management: Monitor ingredient levels, check deliveries, rotate stock, and ensure ingredients are stored correctly and used before their expiry dates.

• 
Food Quality Control: Ensure all dishes meet the required standards for taste, freshness, portion size, and presentation.

• 
Menu Preparation: Assist with menu planning, recipe development, and the preparation of daily specials when required.

• 
Waste Management: Minimise food waste through careful preparation, portion control, and responsible use of ingredients.

• 
Kitchen Organisation: Ensure the kitchen is well prepared for service, with ingredients, equipment, and workstations ready for efficient operation.

• 
Teamwork and Communication: Work closely with the kitchen and front-of-house teams to ensure smooth service and effective communication during busy periods.

• 
Compliance: Follow all relevant food safety procedures, workplace health and safety requirements, and internal kitchen guidelines.

• 
Reliability and Professionalism: Maintain a professional attitude, work independently when required, and contribute to a positive and respectful working environment.

Requirements

• 
Experience working in a professional kitchen is preferred.

• 
Good knowledge of food hygiene, food safety, and safe food handling practices.

• 
Ability to work efficiently and maintain high standards under pressure.

• 
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• 
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• 
A reliable, responsible, and flexible approach to work.

We are looking for a dedicated and motivated chef who takes pride in their work, values quality and cleanliness, and wants to contribute to the daily success of Cafe Svejk.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Attorney for Plesner's IP Team
jobs.description:
Would you like to develop your expertise in intellectual property law and help find solutions to complex legal and commercial challenges? Join Plesner's IP team, where you will work closely with experienced colleagues on both advisory matters and disputes.

We create value together

At Plesner, our IP team advises some of Denmark's leading businesses, international corporations and growth companies on complex legal matters and commercial solutions within intellectual property law, including patents, trademarks, copyright and design rights, as well as marketing and consumer law and life sciences.

You will join a highly skilled team where we work closely together across different levels of experience and areas of expertise. We have high ambitions, value an informal working environment and believe in supporting each other to find the best possible solutions for our clients.

As an assistant attorney, you will have the opportunity to work on both advisory matters and disputes, including litigation. Our team's work includes:

• 
handling disputes and litigation, particularly within intellectual property, marketing and consumer law

• 
advising on life sciences, marketing and consumer law, including regulatory matters and compliance

• 
drafting complex IP agreements

• 
assisting with investigations and assessments of intellectual property, marketing and consumer law, and life sciences matters in connection with M&A transactions.

You will be given responsibility early on and work on complex mattersin close collaboration with experienced colleagues and partners.

About you

We are looking for a recent law graduate or an assistant attorney with 1–2 years of experience. What matters most is your intellectual curiosity, commitment and motivation to develop your expertise within our practice areas.

You have a strong academic background, an analytical mindset and a thorough approach to your work. You enjoy tackling complex legal challenges, take initiative and are motivated by learning from and collaborating with highly skilled colleagues.

You communicate clearly and precisely in both Danish and English and are curious about how new technologies, including AI, can support and enhance your legal work.

Your learning and development

At Plesner, you will be given responsibility from day one, with experienced colleagues to guide and support you. You will become part of an environment where professional guidance, knowledge sharing and close collaboration across all levels are part of everyday life.

We see your time as an assistant attorney as an opportunity to learn and grow. As your skills develop, you will gradually take on more complex assignments and build your capabilities as a legal advisor.

You will be assigned a talent developer who will support your professional and personal development throughout your time as an assistant attorney. You will also have access to a wide range of courses and learning opportunities and participate in the mandatory training programme offered by the Danish Bar and Law Society.

Flexibility, professional excellence and teamwork

At Plesner, we offer:

• 
competitive salary and attractive terms of employment

• 
a working environment combining high professional ambitions, strong team spirit and an informal atmosphere

• 
continuous training and support throughout your time as an assistant attorney

• 
excellent opportunities to build and expand your professional network

• 
a wide range of social and sports activities, including running, yoga and padel.

Learn more about life as an assistant attorney at Plesner on our career page.

We look forward to hearing from you

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application, CV, academic transcripts and any other relevant documents as soon as possible.

If you would like to know more about the position or Plesner, please feel free to contact HR Manager Marlene Tang at +45 33 12 11 33.

A leading law firm focused on relationships and development

Plesner is one of Denmark's largest independent law firms, with more than 600 colleagues. Relationships, trust and legal expertise are at the heart of everything we do. We foster an inclusive culture that values diversity and personal development.

Our strong international network enables us to provide legal advice across borders, while our history of more than 100 years reflects our longstanding commitment to legal excellence.

Learn more about our culture and what it is like to work at Plesner on our career page.

jobs.occupation: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) wanted for strong, supportive team
jobs.description:
Design solutions that solve whole classes of problems rather than individual tasks. As a Senior SRE at Systematic, you keep the systems running that healthcare staff and patients depend on.

Would you like to shape the future of our infrastructure by designing scalable, elegant solutions that solve classes of problems rather than individual tasks? Join our skilled Site Reliability Engineering team where you’ll have the opportunity to think beyond the immediate fix and architect systems that transform how we operate at scale. Your work will keep healthcare solutions running for the clinicians and care staff who depend on them.

The job

As a Senior SRE with a systems engineering mindset, you’ll work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and strategic thinking. You’ll identify patterns across our diverse infrastructure, from Kubernetes clusters to Azure VMs, and create unified solutions that eliminate entire categories of operational toil. This isn’t about fixing one deployment pipeline; it’s about building a framework that makes all deployments reliable. This isn’t about patching one vulnerability; it’s about architecting a security posture that scales across our organization.

You’ll have access to cutting-edge technologies and the autonomy to innovate, with opportunities to work across multiple environments including our ao-admin Kubernetes cluster, Docker-based deployments, Azure-hosted infrastructure, and healthcare-focused systems. When you are ready, you will join the SRE team’s on-call rotation.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Architect automation systems that eliminate classes of manual work, thinking in terms of platforms and capabilities rather than individual scripts

• Develop infrastructure tooling that empowers development teams to self-service their operational needs while maintaining reliability standards

• Build observability frameworks that provide unified insights across diverse environments, making patterns visible and actionable

• Create abstraction layers that hide complexity while providing powerful capabilities, whether through Terraform modules, Helm charts, or custom operators

• Drive infrastructure evolution by identifying systemic improvements and leading their implementation from concept to production

• Collaborate with development teams to understand their patterns of needs and design operations-ready solutions that scale

• Mentor team members in systems thinking and architectural approaches, sharing your problem-solving methodology

• Apply best practices in site reliability engineering, advocating for solutions that improve reliability, security, and maintainability at scale

• Research and prototype emerging technologies and approaches, evaluating their fit for solving our systemic challenges

Joining the team

You’ll join one of our two skilled SRE teams, each consisting of approximately 10 professionals working from our offices in Aarhus and Bucharest. Our teams operate with a DevOps philosophy and use a mix of Scrum and Kanban methodologies depending on the project needs.

We value engineers who can see the forest and the trees, who understand both the technical details and the broader patterns. You’ll work with colleagues who manage everything from Kubernetes clusters to Windows VMs, from Terraform modules to Prometheus monitoring, and you’ll help us find the common threads that allow us to operate more efficiently and reliably.

This is a role with significant room to manoeuvre and influence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with the newest technologies while solving real operational challenges that impact critical systems across multiple domains. Our healthcare solutions, such as Columna, support the continuum of care across hospitals, communities and private homes, so your work contributes directly to patient safety.

Your qualifications

Our ideal candidate is someone who gets excited about patterns, who sees a specific problem and immediately starts thinking “what other problems does this represent?” You’re the engineer who, when asked to automate a deployment, designs a deployment framework. When asked to fix a monitoring gap, you create an observability strategy.

Our ideal candidate would have:

• Experience as a Senior in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering roles with demonstrated impact on infrastructure scalability

• Solid understanding of abstraction and design patterns in infrastructure, with experience creating reusable frameworks, modules, or platforms

• Experience with observability at scale, including metrics, logging, and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)

• Strong communication skills to articulate architectural decisions, document systems, and mentor others in systems thinking

• Proven ability to architect solutions that solve multiple problems simultaneously, with examples of platforms or systems you’ve built

We value diverse backgrounds and encourage candidates who are passionate about systems thinking, infrastructure architecture, and solving problems at scale to apply, even if they do not meet every requirement perfectly!

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Gitte Sandahl Bloch Manager, Application Operations, Customer Operations.

Help secure reliable operations today — and support the transition into LEO Pharma’s future production setup.

At LEO Pharma, we go beyond the skin to make a lasting difference for people living with skin diseases. Behind that mission is a strong technical foundation, and in this role, you will help ensure that foundation is reliable, compliant and future-ready.

Join LEO Pharma in Ballerup and take on a key technical role at an exciting time of change. As Maintenance Support Professional, you will help keep critical technical installations running, support compliance-based maintenance, and contribute to the proper and structured close-down of the old factory as we prepare for a new innovative production facility to fully take over.

**

Your role**

You will provide technical support for the planning, implementation and development of maintenance across utilities, technical installations, plants and production equipment at Site Ballerup. You will act as a technical problem-solver, resolve technical issues in daily operations while also supporting larger transformation activities related to the factory transition.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Supporting day-to-day operation and availability of both the old and state of the art technical installations and equipment.

• Acting as troubleshooter on ad hoc technical assignments, breakdowns and operational challenges.

• Ensuring maintenance documentation is maintained, optimized and aligned with LEO Pharma policies and GxP requirements.

• Creating, Reviewing and technically approving documents in QMS in close collaboration with stakeholders.

• Supporting the structured close-down of the old factory and contributing to a smooth transition towards the new facility.

You will also be responsible for GxP documentation from the section, including documentation in CMMS and QMS. In addition, you will support timely follow-up on deviations, corrective actions, action items and CAPAs, and act as technical SME in root cause analysis related to deviation handling. You may also participate in relevant CAPEX projects as participant or package owner and lead smaller OPEX projects.

**

Your qualifications**

We imagine that you bring solid technical expertise, good documentation discipline and experience from a regulated environment. You are used to working across functions and can communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.

We are looking for someone with:

• An educational background as an engineer, marine engineer, process technician or equivalent.

• 5+ years’ experience with maintenance of utilities, technical installations, plants or production equipment.

• Hands-on experience with deviation handling, root cause analysis, CAPAs or similar processes.

• Knowledge of GxP, technical documentation and regulated quality processes.

• Experience with CMMS systems such as PEMAC and quality systems such as Veeva Quality is an advantage.

• Experience with RCM (Reliability Centered Maintenance) is an advantage.

As a person, you are proactive, structured and solution-oriented. You enjoy troubleshooting, can manage several tasks at the same time, and are motivated by collaborating across departments to find practical and compliant solutions. You communicate with confidence, build trust with stakeholders and contribute to a positive, LEAN-oriented culture. Working with an optimisation perspective and a focus towards improvements.

**

Your new team**

You will join Maintenance Support at Site Ballerup. We are a team that plays an important role in securing stable technical operations and compliant maintenance. We work closely with Operational Maintenance, Engineering, production areas and laboratories, and we support both daily operations and strategic site changes. Together, we are helping LEO Pharma close one chapter in a responsible way while preparing for the next generation of innovative production.

**

Contact and application**

For additional information, please contact Adam Lundsby Rejkjaer, Senior Team Leader, Maintenance Support at BDYDK@leo-pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact.  Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

• 
Vendor audits by pharma customers

• 
Part 11 or Annex 11 systems in practice

• 
Provenance or lineage systems (W3C PROV)

• 
Customer security questionnaires

• 
Kubernetes

• 
TypeScript or Python

You don't need deep frontend skills, lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

About Dalea

Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• 
Language: English

• 
Start: when the round closes

How to apply

Apply here with your LinkedIn profile, your CV and short answers to a few questions. No cover letter needed.

We're also hiring a Senior AI Engineer. You're welcome to apply for more than one.

For more information or questions please contact us at recruiting@dalea.tech

R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

You are structured, proactive and analytical, with a strong sense of ownership and quality. You enjoy working with fixed deadlines, multiple stakeholders and continuous process improvement.

Moreover, you have a keen sense of quality, and you:

• Hold a master’s degree in finance, accounting, auditing, or a similar field

• Have several years of relevant experience from Group consolidation, financial reporting, or an international audit firm

• Have hands-on experience with consolidation processes and a good understanding of the flow from local entity reporting to Group reporting

• Have experience with financial reporting systems. Experience with systems such as OneStream, HFM or Microsoft Dynamics is an advantage

• Are comfortable working independently, driving tasks to completion and collaborating across functions and geographies

• Speak and write fluent English

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferrable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

To apply, use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 19 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

#LI-GNGroup

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.

• Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.

• Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).

**

**About The Job

We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications. As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.

You will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. In this role, you will drive growth by securing net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization.

You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.

Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.860000 - kr.880000 (DKK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .
